primary: Task scores /12, separately coding and judgment; no significance claims
usage: Backend receipt input, cached input, output, reasoning; checked against CLI turn.completed. Cached tokens are included in input, not added. No guessed dollar costs.
wall_time: Container invocation to exit, including retrieval, shell calls, retries. Preparation and grading excluded and separately noted.
output_budget: Prompt limits 12000 generated tokens and 2200 final tokens; observed adherence, not provider hard cap. 300 seconds hard outer timeout; 24 model requests and20 retrieval requests maximum.
comparability: Both offline stdlib environments, treatment adds read-only frozen methods API. This measures adding this curated resource to pretrained knowledge, not equivalence to general web search or a flat-document RAG baseline.
isolation: Per-task fresh Docker network none and tmpfs home; no credentials, vault, history, hooks, user config, skills, gold or other candidates mounted. Only dedicated per-run UDS broker. Base broker rejects methods and other run IDs.
limitations: Four synthetic tasks selected after seeing catalog metadata; task selection favors corpus coverage.
One run per task per condition; execution-order, cache and stochastic noise remain.
Model-blind assessment is an expertise proxy, not human expert/user utility.
Two coding tasks use 12 correlated checks each; not 24 independent tasks.
Source quality, preference adherence across unrelated tasks, and real-world deployment outcomes are not established.
